If either bound controller component changes, the coordinator refreshes immutable fixtures and paired checks before final acceptance. Documentation-only cleanup does not invalidate unchanged component bindings.

## GitHub validation and gated activation

- Publish the completed correction through the established signed workflow. Obtain fresh independent review bound to the final head, dev base, and complete task digest.
